name: Sadagaat
mission: Sadagaat seeks to contribute to improving the educational services of the poor segments by focusing on the education of special groups (children who are not enrolled in schools and the blind), in addition to improving the educational environment, building the capacities of the educational staff, and providing opportunities for professional education.
theoryOfChange: Sadagaat-USA also aims to be the most trusted Go-To USA based organization to serve the underprivileged communities in Sudan. Sadagaat-USA is aiming to combat the vicious Poverty - Ignorance - Disease triangles in Sudan. The organization aims at encouraging the community, particularly youth, to become more involved in community service utilizing their efforts, skills, capabilities and expertise to serve community needs.

strengths_deep_dive: Sadagaat demonstrates remarkable operational efficiency by directing <cite id="1">97.7% of expenses to programs in FY2024</cite> [1]. This performance easily beats the <cite id="1">75% industry standard benchmark</cite> as well as the <cite id="1">88.9% peer median</cite> [1]. Combined with an <cite id="1">overall rating of 97.5/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="1">Platinum Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite>, donors can feel confident in the organization's governance and spending [1].
rich_narrative.summary: Sadagaat is a high-performing international humanitarian organization that provides essential life-saving services, including clean water, food, healthcare, and education to vulnerable communities [1][4]. <cite id="1">Founded in 2002</cite>, the organization has grown significantly, achieving a <cite id="3">3-year revenue CAGR of 67.1%</cite> and generating <cite id="3">$2,368,977 in total revenue in FY2024</cite> [1][3]. Sadagaat delivers programs with exceptional financial efficiency, allocating a <cite id="1">97.7% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, which far exceeds the <cite id="1">75% industry standard</cite> and the <cite id="1">88.9% peer program ratio median</cite> [1]. Additionally, Charity Navigator awards Sadagaat an <cite id="1">overall score of 97.5/100</cite>, reflecting outstanding accountability and governance standards [1]. Sadagaat's programs serve vulnerable populations primarily in Sudan and the United States, reaching over <cite id="1">580,000 beneficiaries</cite> at a highly efficient cost of approximately $3.56 per beneficiary [1][4]. The organization maintains verified <cite id="2">Zakat-eligible programs</cite> targeting the fuqara (poor) and masakin (needy), making it an exceptional choice for faith-based giving [2].
